audit.whatIsWrong: The chart said Darius owns level 1 (8/10) and 2+ items (6/10) and that level 3 is Skill, while the page's own prose says the opposite on all three: 'Kled takes the very first level', 'By level 3 your sustained Hemorrhage out-trades his mounted damage', and 'Late it's skill-dependent'.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is an 800-range hook available at level 1 and Violent Tendencies gives him four accelerated attacks, all before Apprehend exists at all. Level 3 is when Apprehend plus full Decimate come online and the bleed out-sustains him, so that row belongs to Darius, not to Skill. The packet's derived chart reads Kled, Darius, Darius, Darius, Skill, Darius, Skill and matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: win[0] and phases[0] to Kled (4/10), win[2] and phases[2] to Darius (6.5/10), win[6] and phases[6] to Skill (5/10). phases[0].why, phases[2].why and phases[6].why rewritten to match. champ-data/kled.full.js needs the inverse.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every window was described as 'Beartrap on a Rope's cooldown' with no number, and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! was never given a duration.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s, Jousting 13/12/11/10/9s, Violent Tendencies 13/12/11/10/9s and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 140/125/110s. Every one of Kled's abilities costs zero resource, so his only limit is cooldowns - which is exactly why counting them matters more here than in most lanes.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[9].t, phases[4].why, spikes[1].text, wants.you[0] and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the durations.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t was a stub, and Jousting - the ability that actually dodges Apprehend and returns for a second hit - was named nowhere on the page. dontsFull[2].t said 'Chase his W remount' but its description was boilerplate about your own pull.
audit.why: Both champions carry displacement: Apprehend pulls at 535 and Bear Trap yanks at 800, so whoever lands it first owns the trade. Jousting dashes 550 and can be recast to dash back through the same target, which is his escape and his re-engage in one 13s button. Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions, which is the window the execute belongs in.
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten around the two displacements; dontsFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d now name Jousting and the dismount.

audit.why: The packet flagged wants.foe[2] 'Use Violent Tendencies' as a probable wrong ability name. It is not - Violent Tendencies is Kled's real W in champ-data/_kits/kled.json. False positive, left alone.
